name: Kagurazaka Shiki
source:
Represents the Ophiuchus, the 13th constellation. In the fourth game Starry Sky in Winter it's mentioned that he has greater strange power than Kazuki Shiranui. He is a second year.

[Based on [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Starry_Sky#Special_character]Wikipedia[/url]]
